input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use rights to the Company's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and make those rights irrevocable during the term (subject only to Section 4 termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Section 1.4 access and use rights to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our group and third-party developers/agents will need to use the hosting system and administration tools to operate the Site. We also confirmed the rights are irrevocable for the term and cannot be suspended at HDI's discretion outside the Section 4 termination mechanics; if affiliate coverage is a concern, we can accept adding affiliates on written notice to HDI.

ops.oldText: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated
ops.newText: the right for the Company, its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated

ops.oldText: HDI shall also provide the Company with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information.
ops.newText: HDI shall also provide the Company, its affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf with access to HDI's software and Content administration tools for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information and otherwise to exercise its rights under this Agreement. The access and use rights granted under this Section 1.4 shall be irrevocable during the term of this Agreement and may not be suspended or revoked at HDI's discretion, subject only to termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 4.
